sentences.text:
The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C. No.22594/2022 in Crime No.106/2022, registered for offences punishable under Sections-498-A read with Section-34 of the IPC.
2.
During the pendency of these proceedings, it transpires that the parties to the lis have settled the dispute amongst themselves and have filed an application, seeking to compound the offence.

Affidavit reads as follows:
" AFFIDAVIT I Smt.Arjitha Shelke D.G., aged about 36 years, W/o. Sri. Bhonsley P.C.R., residing at No.257, 7th Main Road, KSRTC Layout, 2nd Phase, J.P. Nagar,
Bengaluru - 560 078, do hereby solemnly affirm ad state on oath as follows:
1. I submit that I'am the 2nd respondent in the above case and I'am conversant with the facts of the case and those to which I'am deposing:
2.
I submit that I'am the legally wedded wife of the 1st petitioner.
My marriage was solemnised with 1st petitioner NC: 2024:KHC:27668 on 13.06.2013 at Bengaluru as per Hindu rituals and customs.
The petitioner Nos.2 and 3 are my in-laws respectively.
3. I submit that in our wedlock we begot a girl child on 18.11.2014 and she name as Kum.shaivi.C.
Now my daughter is in care and custody of the 1st petitioner herein and I have visiting rights once in a month on fourth Sunday.

4. I submit that on 30.05.2022 I have lodged a complaint against the petitioners herein for the offence punsiahble under section-498A read with Section 34 of IPC before the 1st respondent J.P.Nagar P.S. therefore 1st respondent has registered FIR on basis of my complaint vide Crime No.0106/2022.
Later on 1st respondent Police have filed a charge-sheet and now same is pending adjudication before the II Additional C.M.M. Court in C.C. No.22594/2022.

5. I submit that my husband i.e., 1st petitioner filed a divorce petition under section 13(1)(i-i) of Hindu Marriage Act against me in M.C. No.4470/2022 and the same is pending consideration before the Hon'ble V Additional Prl. Family Court at Bengaluru.

entities.text: V Additional Prl. Family Court at Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
6. I submit that subsequent to the filing of the above said divorce petition, at the intervention of my parents, well- wishers, and counsels on record, I and 1st petitioner have agreed to settle the disputes amicable,
accordingly we both agreed to dissolve our marriage.

Accordingly, before the Bengaluru Mediation centre we entered into a Memorandum of Settlement under Section-89 of CPC read with Rules 24 Sri.Chethan Bhonsley @ Bhonsley P C R vs State Of Karnataka on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196118492/
3 and 25 of the Karnataka Civil Procedure (Mediation) Rules 2005, in the said M.C. No.4470/2022 on 09.07.2024.

entities.text: Sri.Chethan Bhonsley @ Bhonsley P C R vs State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above settlement and as per the terms and conditions I have agreed to withdraw the said complaint lodged by me in Crime No.106/2022 (now CC No.22594/2022 pending before the 2nd ACMM Court at Bengaluru) and also agreed to cooperate for quashing of the above petition.
Hence, C.C. No.22594/2022 pending before the 2nd ACMM Court at Bengaluru
as I have no objection to quash the same.

NC: 2024:KHC:27668 WHEREFORE, in view of the settlement as aforesaid, I pray that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to quash the above said criminal proceeding before the 2nd ACMM Court at Bengaluru in C.C.No.22594/2022 in Crime No.106/2022 pending against the petitioners herein which registered by the 1st respondent Police for the offence punishable under Section- 498A read with Section-34 of IPC and I have no objection to quash the same in the above case in the interest of justice.

What is stated above is true and correct to the best of my knowledge, information and belief."
3.
In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties, I deem it appropriate to terminate the proceedings against the petitioners in the subject petition by compounding the offences.
4. Therefore, in the light of the settlement and compounding arrived at between the parties as afore- quoted, the following:
ORDER i. Criminal Petition is allowed.
ii. Proceedings pending in C.C. No.22594/2022, in Crime No.106/2022 pending before the 2nd NC: 2024:KHC:27668 ACMM Court at Bengaluru, stands quashed qua the petitioners.

Sd/-
